environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in VPC subnet with task role 'cicd-plugin-task-role'. The task role has s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, s3:CopyObject on 'ci-cd-artifacts-prod/*' and 'deployment-targets-prod/*', plus sts:AssumeRole on 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pipeline-exec-*'. No permission boundary attached to the task role. Service is behind an ALB with no additional request filtering. All pipeline execution roles (pipeline-exec-*) have AdministratorAccess for their respective deployment targets.
